subject: Re: LumenPath pilot — PO requirement and onboarding path
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@lumenpath.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request + vendor form attached

Hi Stephanie / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to run an initial 6-week pilot of Redwood’s Hosted API. Our finance team has a hard rule that small, time-bound pilots (under $15k) are processed as invoice-only to avoid full vendor setup overhead. Would Redwood consider an invoice-first path for the pilot, with a PO to follow if we convert to production?

I’m attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and W-9 for your records (lumenpath_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, lumenpath_w9.pdf). If there are specific evidence items your procurement team needs for an exception (SOC2, insurance, payment terms), please let me know and I’ll get those over.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Invoice for pilot milestone payments (net 30)
- Single point of contact for billing: finance@lumenpath.com
- If pilot converts, we’ll issue a PO for committed monthly spend

Appreciate any flexibility — the pilot has tight timeboxes.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships | LumenPath
Attachments: lumenpath_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (form), lumenpath_w9.pdf (tax form)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@lumenpath.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request + vendor form attached

Hi Maya — thanks for the materials and the quick turnaround.

We can be pragmatic here; Redwood’s procurement policy generally requires a PO for onboarding new vendors, but we do have mechanisms for short pilots. Two options that usually work:

1) Provisional vendor onboarding (90-day window): finance treats the supplier as provisional and we accept invoices for the pilot. If the pilot converts, procurement issues a PO and completes full setup. Requires SOC2 or equivalent plus W-9 and certificate of insurance.

2) Staged PO: we issue a limited PO that covers the pilot cap (e.g., $12k) and then expand the PO on conversion. This gets the vendor into our PO system immediately but keeps exposure limited.

Would LumenPath be comfortable with option 1 if you can share SOC2 or a security attestation and the COI? If not, option 2 is straightforward but we’ll need an internal PO approver to sign off.

Action items for LumenPath:
- Send SOC2 report or security attestation (if available)
- Send proof of insurance (COI)
- Confirm billing contact and PO versus invoice preference

I’ve attached our onboarding checklist to make things faster (redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf). I’ll loop Laura for any PO-exception approval if needed.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request + vendor form attached

Stephanie / Maya — quick operational note from procurement: we can approve a provisional, invoice-only onboarding for pilots under $15k, but we need to formally record the exception and place vendor on a provisional allowlist. Conditions we require:

- Cap the pilot spend in writing (we usually put a $12k cap for 6 weeks)
- Signed statement from vendor acknowledging provisional status and that a PO may be required for ongoing work
- Required documents: W-9 (received), SOC2 or attestation (preferred), COI (insurance)
- Single internal approver assigned (Laura, can you confirm you can sign the exception?)

If approved, procurement will:
- Create a provisional vendor record with expiration (90 days)
- Allow invoice processing via accounts payable with standard net30 terms
- Trigger a fixed follow-up at day 60 to decide PO issuance if conversion looks likely

Maya — if you confirm the cap and can send SOC2/COI (even a recent security questionnaire or attest), I’ll prepare the exception memo for Laura’s signature.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request + vendor form attached

Hi team — I reviewed the thread and the attached W-9. Given the pilot scope and the supporting docs, I approve a 90-day provisional vendor exception under these conditions:

1) Pilot spend cap: $12,000 total
2) Provisional period: 90 days from first invoice date
3) Vendor must sign the provisional exception acknowledgement (I’m attaching a one-page form that LumenPath can sign)
4) Provide COI and SOC2 attestation within 7 business days of first invoice or we reserve the right to pause payments
5) If pilot converts to production, procurement will require a PO before any committed monthly spend begins

Maya — please sign and return the attached acknowledgement (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/lumenpath-msa) and provide COI/SOC2 attestation. Once returned, procurement will create the provisional vendor record and notify AP.

Next steps (internal): Priyom — please draft the exception memo and create the provisional vendor record. Stephanie — coordinate with Maya on the DocuSign and onboarding checklist items.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: provisional_exception_acknowledgement.pdf
